status: Linux 7.3-5 rebase after Surface Laptop 8 #1706; signed-source replay, native AArch64 object/DTB checks and packaging regressions pass. Full native split-package build and physical A16 acceptance remain pending.

patch_review.2500: Rebased after all 357 shared patches, including #1706. Shared LPASS addresses, USB votes, eDP calibration and LINK_RATE_SET refinements are not duplicated. QMP resource tracking/Type-C rollback, DP error cleanup and synchronized altmode snapshots retain shared USB4 ownership, FEC paths and masked V2 mux values. Invalid cable guards return -EINVAL to the acknowledging worker. Failed USB/USB4 initialization drops its tentative reference even if reset cleanup fails; resource ownership remains tracked for recovery.
patch_review.2501: Renumbered from 2301; deferred SoundWire codec behavior retained unchanged.
patch_review.2302: Original A16 block-mq fix remains dropped because Linux 7.3 includes it. Shared patch 2302 is the Surface LPASS regcache change and is retained.
patch_review.2503: Renumbered from 2303; temporary -EAGAIN battery property handling retained unchanged.
patch_review.shared: All 357 shared patches, signatures, checksums and config.aarch64 are retained, including TYPEC=y and USB4_QCOM=m from #1706.

prior_hardware_acceptance.scope: Previously reported native build, source replay, both UKIs, early DSPs, audio, keyboard, touchscreen, charger transitions and Bluetooth calls/audio. These results do not validate Linux 7.3-5.

hardware_required: Boot both UKIs on A16; verify kernel-release/ABI markers and both early DSPs before root mount
Audio playback and microphones; deferred codec reset and recovery
Internal display, HDMI/USB-C output, hotplug, failed-link recovery and power transitions
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth calls/audio, keyboard, touchscreen, USB and storage
Native kernel/modules/headers/source package build, packaged-header module compilation and distributed-source replay
Other ARM-board regression coverage before shared promotion
excluded_acceptance: Camera and suspend remain disabled in the prior bring-up scope; this rebase supplies no hardware acceptance for them. No OEM firmware or omarchy-a16-support recipe is included.
